## Company
Name: Excorp Distribution B.V.
Type: Wholesale FMCG Distributor
Founded: 2023
Registration: Netherlands Chamber of Commerce (KvK) — COC 96822945
Address: Laan van Europa 370, 3317 DB Dordrecht, Netherlands

## What We Do
Excorp Distribution is a premium FMCG wholesale distributor based in Dordrecht, Netherlands.
We supply fast-moving consumer goods to retailers, brands, and B2B clients across Europe and the Middle East.
We specialise in four product categories: Beverages, Food & Grocery, Personal Care, and Home & Cleaning.

## Markets Served
Europe: Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, France
Middle East: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan
